Navellier & Associates Position in Baxter International (BAX) Has Raised by $541,645 as Stock Price Rose; Daniel Devine & Company Cut Apple (AAPL) Position as Stock Rose
June 29, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Louis Navellier increased its stake in Baxter International Inc. (BAX) by 11.23% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Navellier & Associates Inc bought 8,333 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.90% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Louis Navellier held 82,555 shares of the medical and dental instruments company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.37M, up from 74,222 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Navellier & Associates Inc who had been investing in Baxter International Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $39.69 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.43% or $0.32 during the last trading session, reaching $74.12. About 305,133 shares traded. Baxter International Inc. (NYSE:BAX) has risen 22.64% since June 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.07% the S&P500.
